description: This file contains JUnit test cases for the RegistrationMessageFilter class, verifying its correct behavior in filtering registration messages based on tenant and device identifiers.

classes.name: RegistrationMessageFilterTest
classes.description: JUnit test suite for the RegistrationMessageFilter class, ensuring correct message filtering logic.

methods.name: testVerifyDetectsDeviceIdMismatch
methods.description: Tests that the filter correctly rejects messages whose device ID does not match the link target.

methods.name: testVerifyDetectsMissingDeviceId
methods.description: Tests that the filter correctly rejects messages lacking a device ID.

methods.name: testVerifyDetectsMissingAction
methods.description: Tests that the filter correctly rejects messages lacking a valid action/subject.

methods.name: testVerifySucceedsForTenantOnlyLinkTarget
methods.description: Verifies that a message with a tenant-level target passes the filter when the message has proper properties.

methods.name: testVerifySucceedsForMatchingDevice
methods.description: Ensures that a message with matching device ID and link target passes the filter.
